description: Add knowledge to an actor. Choose the kind: expertise for a skill or standard it judges by in every run (brand, tone of voice, design system, compliance, accessibility), process for steps it follows, reference for facts it looks up when relevant (product docs, FAQs, policies), account for test account details. Never pass real passwords, API keys or one-time codes; actors sign in with email codes. Check list_actor_knowledge first to avoid duplicates.

content.description: The knowledge itself as plain text or Markdown, at most 8,000 characters; split longer material into several entries. Be specific and observable, e.g. "Headlines use sentence case; never say 'leverage'."

kind.description: What the entry is for. Defaults to reference.

title.description: Short label for the entry, e.g. "Pricing rules" or "Brand tone of voice". The actor sees titles in every run and opens an entry by its title, so make it say what the entry covers.

name: add_actor_knowledge

id.description: The new knowledge entry UUID, for remove_actor_knowledge.

title: Add actor knowledge
